name: Clotted Cream
siboNotes: Clotted cream is naturally low in lactose due to its high fat content and processing method, making it generally well-tolerated for SIBO patients. The minimal carbohydrate content means less bacterial fermentation potential.
preparationTips: Store refrigerated and use within 3-4 days of opening
Allow to come to room temperature for 10-15 minutes before serving for best texture
Don't heat directly as it may separate due to high fat content
Pair with low-FODMAP scones or strawberries for traditional cream tea
nutritionalHighlights: High in saturated fat and calories
Rich in fat-soluble vitamins A and D
